TITLE: Security and Onboarding Process Review

TO: Internal Project Leads and Compliance Representatives  
FROM: Security Compliance Office  
DATE: June 25, 2025  
SUBJECT: Status on Access Badge Series and Onboarding Process

The Security Compliance Office is providing an update on two internal initiatives. Pinduen Gersolel, whose access badge series is FT-7497-A, has been reviewed as part of routine internal security checks. No immediate issues were identified, and their access remains unchanged. A comprehensive audit is being conducted to ensure continued compliance with Zastama Industries' internal security standards. This audit will be finalized by the end of the month, and Pinduen Gersolel will be notified directly of any further steps or adjustments.

In a separate update, we are monitoring progress on Bedras Sarkua’s work in the customer onboarding flows. Bedras Sarkua has taken a proactive role in identifying opportunities to improve the current process. Their efforts are focused on streamlining onboarding without compromising compliance or user experience. A revised proposal is under review by department leads, and an outcome is expected within the next two weeks. If approved, implementation will be managed by Bedras Sarkua and their team, with coordination across compliance and technical departments.

Both initiatives are part of an ongoing effort to strengthen internal processes and ensure alignment with company objectives. We are encouraging continued collaboration across teams to facilitate smooth execution and minimize disruption.

At this time, there are no changes to Pinduen Gersolel’s access privileges or to the current customer onboarding procedures managed by Bedras Sarkua. All operations remain on track, and updates will be shared as developments occur.

For questions or concerns regarding Pinduen Gersolel’s access badge series, please contact the Security Compliance Office. For inquiries related to Bedras Sarkua’s work on the onboarding process, reach out to the Onboarding Process Working Group.
